newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's Kamei urges 10 trln yen extra budget - Jiji.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Kamei urges 10 trln yen extra budget - Jiji.

text.p: Japan should adopt, before the year's end, a supplementary budget for the current fiscal year to March 31 totalling 10 trillion yen, including three trillion yen worth of fresh government spending, Jiji news agency quoted new Construction Minister Shizuka Kamei as saying.

"If we continue like this without a supplementary budget, the economy will not get on a recovery track," Jiji quoted Kamei as saying in an interview on Friday, adding that the budget should total 10 trillion yen and include three trillion in so-called "real water", or fresh public spending.
